title: EEG, pupillometry, ECG and photoplethysmography, and behavioral data in the digit span task and rest
description: Raw 64-channel EEG, electrocardiography, photoplethysmography, pupillometry and behavioral data from 86 participants during 4 minutes of eyes-closed rest and a digit span serial recall task. Participants memorized or passively listened to auditory digit sequences of 5, 9, or 13 items. The dataset supports work on cognitive load discrimination, event-related and oscillatory dynamics during encoding and maintenance, and links between working memory, central and peripheral physiology.
methods_description: Participants either memorized or listened to (control) auditorily presented sequences of 5, 9, or 13 digits with 2 s stimulus onset asynchrony, followed by serial recall. A 4-minute eyes-closed resting recording was also collected. Data include 64-channel EEG, ECG, PPG, pupillometry/eye tracking, and recall correctness.
